name: Archie learning loop (skill usage ledger, weekly learning report)

knobs.note: BH-4066: 0 stops the daily report run before any read. Read by bin/archie-learn.sh report as ${ARCHIE_LEARN_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-learning.log and the default. Edits through archie-learn.sh edit/correct are not switched by it.

BH-4066: a hub skill with no Skill invocation in the orchestrator's transcripts for this many days (and first seen at least this long ago) is flagged for pruning in the weekly report and by archie-learn.sh unused. Flagging deletes nothing. Read by bin/archie-learn.sh as ${ARCHIE_SKILL_UNUSED_DAYS:-30}; outside 1..365 is one warn line and the default.

BH-4066: USD cap on each replay-gate model call (AGENT_CALL_BUDGET_USD_ARCHIE_REPLAY). 0 makes no call, so every skill edit is rejected (got=none) and nothing is promoted ungated. Read by bin/archie-replay-model.sh as ${ARCHIE_REPLAY_MAX_USD:-0.05}. The default is a proposal for the operator (a spend cap is MUST ASK).

BH-4066: billed failures on one replay prompt (sha256 of model + prompt) before bin/archie-replay-model.sh stops calling for it. Read as ${ARCHIE_REPLAY_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-2}; outside 1..10 is one warn line and the default.

0 makes this lane call no model at all. bin/lib/llm-gate.sh refuses BEFORE the vendor call and writes a zero-cost row_source=refused row, so the stop is visible in the ledger rather than being a lane that went quiet.
Comma/space list of the ONLY ladder rungs this lane may reach. Empty is every rung, i.e. today's ladder unchanged. A rung outside the list is refused before the call.
Dollars this lane may spend in the current UTC day, summed from D1 cost_rows through GET /api/metrics/llm-spend, never from the box's own logs/cost.csv.

Not a knob: the orchestrator's home, read by bin/archie-learn.sh and bin/orchestrate.sh as ${ARCHIE_ORC_DIR:-/root/orchestrator} (learned/, .claude/skills/, facts.md). A test seam. NOT settable from the control plane.

Not a knob: where bin/archie-learn.sh reads the repo's skills with their replays, ${ARCHIE_SKILLS_SRC:-${HARNESS_CHECKOUT:-/root/harness-checkout}/orchestrator/skills}. A test seam. NOT settable from the control plane.
Not a knob: the box's harness checkout (default /root/harness-checkout), read by bin/archie-learn.sh to find orchestrator/skills. Plumbing. NOT settable from the control plane.

Not a knob: the orchestrator's Claude Code transcripts, read by bin/archie-learn.sh as ${ARCHIE_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR:-/root/.claude/projects/-root-orchestrator}. A test seam. NOT settable from the control plane.

Not a knob: the replay model bin/archie-learn.sh hands bin/archie-skill-replay.sh, default bin/archie-replay-model.sh (metered, stage archie-replay). A test seam: it names a command a root lane runs. NOT settable from the control plane.
Not a knob: bin/archie-learn.sh sets it when it re-executes itself under timeout 600. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-learn.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam: a file bin/archie-learn.sh and bin/archie-replay-model.sh source after their libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/archie-learn.sh honours ARCHIE_NOW and sources ARCHIE_LEARN_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
